title: Fixed Wall-Hung Urinal Appearance
description: Original static wall-hung urinal appearance: one continuous thick ceramic shell connects a tall shallow upper splash region to a deeper protruding lower bowl through a real front-open recess and turned rim, with a closed interior back and floor. Two fixed rear mounting-boss appearances are separate complete meshes. Newly authored geometry, not a rotated or resized toilet, sink table or drinking station. No seat, pedestal, cistern, sensor, person, water or claimed drain hole. Lowest ceramic point is a local model datum, not a floor support surface. Rear mounting reference is appearance only. No flushing, drainage, plumbing, hygiene, accessibility, load, installation or safety performance; preview wall is excluded from the GLB.
